Second barrier off the same lever: the fused scan re-zeroes each histogram bucket as it reads it (block_find_pivot_bucket_rep<CLEAR=true>), so the per-pass clear loop and its barrier go away and a radix pass runs 3 block barriers instead of 4. Zero LDS cost, unlike double-buffering the histogram (+4 KB would cut phase_a 4 -> 3 blocks/CU at S=8192). Exact, not opportunistic: thread t owns slots [t*HIST_REP,(t+1)*HIST_REP) and blocks are always >= 256 threads, so the 256 scanning threads cover all HIST_SLOTS once. A REGIME TRADE: anchor 609.3 -> 607.2 us (-0.35%), M=1 N=1M -0.8%, decode -0.8%, prefill -0.8%, against small_n M=4096 N=8192 +1.8% (small_n regime geomean 27.52 -> 27.64, +0.40%, inside the 0.5% band).
